properties.name: Ebbetts Pass Corridor
properties.note: Hand-drawn coverage wedge (replaces the coarse square bbox). Follows the Hwy 4 corridor Angels Camp -> Bear Valley, bulges NW to the Tiger Creek forest above Arnold, and extends SE up Hwy 108 into the Stanislaus NF (Pinecrest/Dodge Ridge). Excludes San Andreas & Jackson (NW) and Farmington (SW). Exterior ring is CCW per RFC 7946. Coordinates are [lng, lat].
